mcqs.question: Which of the following radian measures is exactly equal to 150°?
mcqs.explanation: 150° = 150\u00b0 \times \u03c0/180 = 5\u03c0/6 rad. Option B matches this value. The other options correspond to 60°, 120°, and 90° respectively, which are not equal to 150°.

mcqs.learning_point: Relate arc length to angle measure
mcqs.question: A circle has radius 7 cm. If an arc of this circle is 14 cm long, what is the measure of the central angle in radians?
mcqs.explanation: Arc length s = r\theta. Hence \theta = s/r = 14/7 = 2 rad. Option B is correct; the others represent different ratios of arc length to radius.

mcqs.question: In degree measure, a complete revolution around a point corresponds to how many degrees?
mcqs.explanation: A full circle is defined as 360 degrees. Therefore option B is correct; the other options represent half, quarter, and three‑quarters of a full turn.

mcqs.question: One radian is the angle subtended at the centre of a circle by an arc whose length is equal to:

options.D: twice the radius of the circle

mcqs.explanation: By definition, a radian is the angle for which the arc length equals the radius. Hence option B is correct; the other choices describe different lengths.

mcqs.question: Convert 45° into radians (in terms of \u03c0).
mcqs.explanation: Radians = degrees \times \u03c0/180. Thus 45\u00b0 = 45 \times \u03c0/180 = \u03c0/4. Option B is correct; the others correspond to 90°, 30°, and 22.5° respectively.

mcqs.question: A wheel rotates through an angle of \u03c0/3 radians. What is this angle in degrees?
mcqs.explanation: Degrees = radians \times 180/\u03c0. So (\u03c0/3) \times 180/\u03c0 = 60\u00b0. Option C is correct; the other options are results of different radian values.

mcqs.learning_point: Relate arc length to angle measure
mcqs.question: A circle has radius 5 cm. Find the length of the arc subtended by a central angle of 60\u00b0.
mcqs.explanation: First convert 60\u00b0 to radians: 60\u00b0 = \u03c0/3 rad. Arc length s = r\theta = 5 \times (\u03c0/3) = 5\u03c0/3 cm. Hence option A is correct; the others are incorrect calculations.

mcqs.question: The minute hand of a clock moves from the 12 o\'clock position to the 3 o\'clock position. By how many degrees has it rotated?
mcqs.explanation: Moving from 12 to 3 covers one quarter of the clock face. One quarter of 360\u00b0 is 90\u00b0. Therefore option B is correct; the other options represent smaller or larger fractions of the full circle.
